requirement.statement: The runtime SHALL project a closed trusted comparison/null/and/or RuntimeQuery predicate to immutable public depa ORM AST nodes without raw SQL or value interpolation, capture one system-owned UTC recordedAt per admitted execution and share it with every parent/child handler context, reject timeline mismatches before allocation, and fail closed with READ_ONLY_OPERATION_WRITE_REJECTED before Writer IO when an effect=read-only operation attempts a mutation.

suite.name: Temporal query, clock, and effect boundary

case.given: a nested predicate for valid and recorded lower-inclusive upper-exclusive intervals with nullable upper bounds
case.then: Comparison, IsNull, AND, and OR nodes SHALL preserve the predicate; every value SHALL use Literal and no raw SQL SHALL be accepted

case.given: an admitted parent operation that invokes registered children
case.when: the execution runtime obtains system time
case.then: the clock SHALL be read once and the same UTC recordedAt SHALL be visible to parent and child contexts while another execution obtains its own value

case.given: a read-only definition whose faulty handler calls context.write inside an outer transaction
case.then: Writer IO SHALL not run, the transaction SHALL commit no mutation, and response diagnostics SHALL contain READ_ONLY_OPERATION_WRITE_REJECTED

case.given: a well-shaped request whose timeline does not match its catalog definition
case.then: compile, initialize, seed, handler, probe, and destroy allocation stages SHALL not start
